brief: Prioritise Fairmount Heights 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-335) for pre-event attention, and where an obstruction defect is outstanding, ensure clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity as specified in SOP-011. Because this ageing unit cannot be attended before the heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure in accordance with MG-023. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period as required by MG-021.
